method.cache: fresh browser context per run (cold cache)
method.successCriteria: Button present, computed padding 16px, useColorMode returned a value
method.sizes: JavaScript module requests only; transferred = bytes on the wire (CDP encodedDataLength, so compression counts), decoded = decompressed body length
method.span: first to last JavaScript module request, including incomplete graphs for failed runs
method.standaloneHost: the Rollup standalone artifact is served brotli-compressed from localhost, as a real origin would

strategies.label: Default ESM
strategies.note: Failure case: no import map, and esm.sh's CommonJS wrapper for react-focus-lock throws before the app mounts.

strategies.label: Default ESM + import map
strategies.note: Failure case: `?external=react,react-dom` plus an import map, unbundled entry.

strategies.label: Standalone bundle
strategies.note: `?standalone&external=react,react-dom`: esm.sh merges the package and its own dependencies into one file, then an import map supplies the peers.

strategies.label: Standalone bundle, no peer map
strategies.note: Failure case: `?standalone` bundles its own React, so hooks run on a second instance.

strategies.label: `+esm`, no import map
strategies.note: Failure case: jsDelivr pins each peer to its own version.

strategies.label: `+esm` bundle
strategies.note: jsDelivr bundles each package into one file and pins every dependency to an absolute URL; the alias map collapses those URLs onto the pinned peers.

strategies.label: `+esm` with Emotion pinned too
strategies.note: Variant of jsDelivr `+esm`: the alias map covers Emotion as well as React.

strategies.label: Standalone artifact
strategies.note: The npm-published `dist/standalone/index.min.js` served by jsDelivr. Measured only when the published tarball contains the artifact; otherwise the probe records a 404 and the row is left unmeasured.

strategies.label: Standalone artifact, jsDelivr peers
strategies.note: Variant: the published standalone bundle with the React family and Emotion served by jsDelivr, so one origin serves everything.

strategies.label: Standalone artifact
strategies.note: `packages/react/dist/standalone/index.min.js` served from your own origin; an import map supplies the six bare peer imports.

strategies.label: Standalone artifact, no import map
strategies.note: Failure case: the bundle keeps six bare imports; nothing resolves them.
strategies.failure: Failed to resolve module specifier "react". Relative references must start with either "/", "./", or "../".

strategies.label: esm.sh entry, jsDelivr React
strategies.note: Variant: the library entry stays on esm.sh, the React family comes from jsDelivr.
